metadata.description: Abracadabrax media plugins for Claude: images, videos and songs rendered in your Abracadabrax account.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-image-video
plugins.description: AI image generator and AI video generator: turn a text prompt into an image or a video, pick model, format and length with Claude, and render it with your Abracadabrax credits.

plugins.name: abracadabrax-song-maker
plugins.description: AI song and music maker: write lyrics with Claude and have Abracadabrax sing and produce the track, or create an instrumental, rendered with your Abracadabrax credits.
